ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between low-intensity dark central pigmentation and high-intensity white/light-grey lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A dark, contiguous pigment zone occupies the central and lower-central regions. Lateral lobes transition to high-intensity white backgrounds heavily mottled with isolated dark-pixel circular spots and irregular patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior vertex point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased jaggedness toward the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinctly convex curvature across the superior trailing edges of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular rings (rosette scars) are clustered on the upper-outer quadrants of both lobes, featuring dark outer boundaries and light centers.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, high-intensity linear scratches visible across the dark central pigment area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including numerous circular barnacle attachment marks and multi-directional rake marks/abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense distribution of circular scars specifically on the outer trailing edges.
